title: Enablement plan: Sales/CS/Support for cloud marketplace procurement + onboarding
creator: Chris Osei
description:
Build and ship an enablement package so Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support can reliably guide marketplace buyers through: procurement → subscription → entitlement → Redwood org provisioning → first API key → first successful request → metering/invoicing.

This ticket focuses on: internal training, a customer-facing-ready FAQ (plus internal talk track), escalation paths + routing rules, and support macros/templates for common marketplace procurement/onboarding issues.

Primary outcomes:
- Reduce time-to-first-success for marketplace buyers by making internal guidance consistent and actionable.
- Reduce support load and back-and-forth for predictable issues (entitlement propagation delays, org linking, private offer activation, billing dimension confusion).
- Ensure consistent messaging aligned with PMM-approved claims and Security-reviewed statements.

Non-goals:
- Implement product changes (tracked in ENG tickets).
- Rewrite full docs IA (tracked in ENG-22113 / docs PRs).

Stakeholders / contributors:
- Sales/GTM: Jordan Blake, Stephanie Nguyen, Lukas Meyer
- PMM/Marketing: Soojin Lee, Camila Reyes
- CS/Support: Jasmine Liu (DRI), Dev Patel (Support escalation owner), Rachel Kim
- Solutions Engineering: Markus Klein
- Security/GRC: Naomi Feldman, Dr. Aisha Rahman, Olga Petrov (for evidence gating language)
- Eng: Chloe Martin (console onboarding), Ethan Park (control plane), Cole Summers (billing hooks)
acceptance_criteria:
1) Internal enablement page published (single source of truth) with: procurement flow, onboarding steps, common failure modes, escalation matrix, and updated links.
2) Marketplace FAQ finalized and approved by PMM + Security for externally shareable content; internal talk tracks included.
3) Support macros/templates created for top 8 marketplace issues, with required fields and next-action checklist.
4) Clear routing rules defined: when Support handles vs when to pull in SE vs when to escalate to Eng/Security/Finance.
5) Training delivered (live) + recording + slide deck posted; attendance from Sales/SE/CS/Support; office hours scheduled for first 2 weeks post-launch.
6) Tags/fields agreed for case tracking (so we can measure post-launch support volume and top drivers).
plan:
Deliverables
A) Enablement hub (internal)
- Location: Confluence (GTM Enablement → Marketplace) and linked from Launch Brief
- Sections:
  - What changed in the refresh (new SKUs, onboarding flow, security packet, who to contact)
  - Buyer journeys (AWS vs GCP) with screenshots
  - Supported purchase paths (public offer vs private offer)
  - Entitlement + provisioning troubleshooting
  - Metering/billing FAQs (high level)
  - Escalation matrix + SLAs
  - Approved copy blocks / do-not-say list

B) Training
- 60 min live session (recorded): “Marketplace procurement + onboarding: how to unblock customers fast”
- Audience: AEs, SEs, CSMs, Support
- Includes: 15 min demo (staging) of subscription → org linking → key creation, and 15 min troubleshooting lab
- Follow-up: 2 office-hour blocks (30 min) during launch week

C) FAQ (customer-facing-ready) + internal talk track
- Maintain one canonical doc; internal talk track includes additional detail not published externally
- Ensure security statements match security packet wording (no ad hoc claims)

D) Support macros (templates)
- Create macros for top issues with required info checklist, time expectations, and escalation triggers
- Ensure macros explicitly reference: “entitlement propagation can take up to X minutes” (confirm with Eng; update once final)

E) Routing + escalation
- Define L1/L2 boundaries, on-call expectations (business hours), and which Slack channels/Jira projects to use
- Include after-hours guidance and what constitutes P0/P1 for marketplace onboarding

Milestones
- Draft enablement hub + macros: 2026-02-07
- Cross-functional review (PMM + Support + Security): 2026-02-10
- Final publish + training delivered: week of 2026-02-17
- Office hours: 2026-02-18 and 2026-02-20
training_agenda:
Training: Marketplace procurement + onboarding enablement (60 minutes)
1) Context (5m)
- Why marketplace refresh; what changed
- Success metrics: time-to-first-token, conversion, support ticket volume

2) Offer types + what Sales should ask upfront (10m)
- AWS: public offer vs private offer (discounts/terms handled via Partnerships/Legal)
- GCP: procurement steps; who owns approvals
- What info to capture: cloud account ID/project, intended SKU, region/residency needs, existing Redwood org?

3) Onboarding walkthrough (15m)
- Subscribe → entitlement verification → org provisioning/linking → API key → first request
- Demo key screens; where to find error codes

4) Top failure modes + troubleshooting (15m)
- Entitlement propagation delay / sync lag
- Existing org linking and multi-subscription edge cases
- Billing dimension mismatch / wrong SKU mapping symptoms
- Private offer activation timing

5) Escalation matrix + SLAs (10m)
- When to route to Support vs SE vs Eng vs Security
- What artifacts are needed to escalate (subscription ID, marketplace account/project, timestamps, error code, org ID)

6) Q&A (5m)

Artifacts
- Slide deck
- Recording
- “Cheat sheet” one-pager for AEs/CSMs
support_macros:
Support macros/templates (draft v0.3)

Macro 1: Entitlement not found after subscription
Subject: Marketplace subscription received — entitlement is still propagating
Body:
Thanks for subscribing via {AWS/GCP} Marketplace. Sometimes marketplace entitlements take time to propagate to Redwood.

To help us validate quickly, please reply with:
- Cloud provider: AWS or GCP
- Marketplace subscription identifier (AWS: CustomerIdentifier / Entitlement ID; GCP: Procurement Account / Order ID)
- Timestamp of purchase/acceptance (with timezone)
- Redwood org name (if already created) and the email used to sign in

Next steps:
1) Please wait {X–Y} minutes after acceptance, then retry the “Verify entitlement” step in the Redwood Console.
2) If it still fails, we’ll validate entitlement sync on our side and follow up.

If this is blocking a production deployment, tell us your deadline and we’ll prioritize.

Macro 2: Org linking for an existing Redwood org
Subject: Link your marketplace subscription to an existing Redwood org
Body:
You can link your marketplace subscription to an existing Redwood organization.

Please confirm:
- Redwood org ID or org name
- Admin email for that org
- Do you want this subscription linked to the existing org, or should we create a new org?

If you see an error in Console, include:
- Error code/message
- Screenshot (optional)
- Timestamp

Macro 3: Multi-subscription / duplicate subscription
Subject: Multiple marketplace subscriptions detected — choosing the right org/subscription
Body:
It looks like there may be multiple marketplace subscriptions associated with your account.

To resolve, please send:
- All relevant marketplace subscription IDs (or a screenshot of the marketplace subscription page)
- Which Redwood org should receive the entitlement
- Desired SKU/plan name

We’ll confirm the active subscription and ensure entitlements are correctly applied.

Macro 4: Private offer activation timing
Subject: AWS private offer accepted — when does Redwood access update?
Body:
After you accept an AWS private offer, updated terms/entitlements may take a short time to activate.

Please share:
- Offer acceptance timestamp
- AWS account ID and subscription ID
- Redwood org name

We’ll verify activation and confirm when new limits/quotas should apply.

Macro 5: Billing dimension mismatch / unexpected line items
Subject: Marketplace billing question — verifying dimensions and usage mapping
Body:
Thanks for flagging this. Marketplace billing dimensions must align to the SKU you purchased and your Redwood usage.

To investigate, please share:
- Cloud provider + subscription ID
- Redwood org ID
- Time range where you saw the unexpected dimension
- (If available) a screenshot or exported billing line items

We’ll validate the mapping and confirm whether this is expected behavior or a configuration issue.

Macro 6: Region / residency / data retention question
Subject: Marketplace security + data handling details
Body:
We can share our marketplace security overview covering encryption, logging, retention defaults, and shared responsibility.

Please tell us:
- Which deployment mode you’re using (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Required region(s) / residency constraints
- Any retention requirements (e.g., 0-day logs, custom retention)

We’ll point you to the appropriate security packet sections and confirm what’s configurable for your plan.

Macro 7: Need help with first API call
Subject: Getting to your first successful API call (marketplace)
Body:
Here are the quick steps:
1) Verify your entitlement in the Redwood Console
2) Create or link your Redwood org
3) Create an API key
4) Make a test request (we recommend a minimal prompt + streaming off initially)

If you share the language/SDK you’re using and any error message + request ID, we can debug quickly.

Macro 8: Escalation acknowledgment (internal use)
Subject: We’re escalating your marketplace onboarding issue
Body:
We’ve escalated your issue to {Eng/Security/Finance} and will update you by {ETA}.

To keep things moving, please confirm:
- Subscription ID
- Org ID
- Error code/message
- Timestamp + timezone

Thanks — we’ll follow up as soon as we have confirmation.
escalation_matrix:
Escalation matrix (draft)

L1 Support (Support queue owner: Dev Patel)
Handles:
- Basic onboarding guidance (where to click, how to create API key)
- Entitlement retry guidance (within expected propagation window)
- FAQ responses that do not require account-specific investigation
SLA target:
- First response: < 4 business hours

L2 CS / CSM (owner: Jasmine Liu / Rachel Kim)
Handles:
- Customer onboarding coordination across teams
- Managing expectations with procurement timelines
- High-touch customers who need guided onboarding
Triggers:
- Enterprise buyer; purchase is blocking a launch
- Repeated failures or confusion after L1 steps

Solutions Engineering (owner: Markus Klein)
Handles:
- Implementation help, architecture questions, proof-of-success
Triggers:
- Customer needs a live walkthrough
- Complicated environment constraints (VPC/Private, KMS, SIEM export)

Engineering Escalation (owners: Chloe Martin for Console UX; Ethan Park for entitlement; Cole Summers for billing)
Use when:
- Entitlement verification fails beyond expected window
- Console error codes indicate server-side issue
- Suspected metering/billing dimension mapping bug
SLA target:
- Acknowledgment: < 1 business day (P1), < 4 hours (P0 launch blocker)

Security/GRC (owners: Naomi Feldman / Olga Petrov)
Use when:
- Customer requests evidence beyond the published security packet
- Security questionnaire requires confirmation / custom wording

Finance/Legal (owners: Laura Bennett / Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes)
Use when:
- Private offer terms questions, refunds/credits, invoicing disputes

Where to escalate:
- Internal Slack channels: #partnerships (marketplace), #support (triage), #eng-platform (entitlement sync), #finance (billing/revrec), #eng-security (security claims)
- Ticketing:
  - Customer-facing issues: Jira SUP project (link support case)
  - Internal engineering follow-up: Linear ENG tickets referenced in the enablement hub
faq_outline:
FAQ outline (customer-facing-ready, needs final review)
1) Can I buy Redwood via AWS/GCP Marketplace? What do I get?
2) What’s the difference between Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private through marketplace?
3) How does subscription map to my Redwood organization?
4) How long does provisioning take?
5) What if I already have a Redwood org?
6) Can I have multiple marketplace subscriptions?
7) How does usage metering work? Where do I see usage and charges?
8) What happens when I accept an AWS private offer?
9) Security: encryption, KMS, audit logs, retention, and shared responsibility
10) Support: how to contact support, expected response times, and what info to include
11) Troubleshooting: entitlement not found, linking failures, billing dimension confusion

Internal-only addendum:
- Competitive objection handling and routing guidance (don’t include in customer-facing FAQ)
- Discount guardrails and approvals process for private offers
